The item directly downstream of E-2-1 is FV-2-2, a globe valve. Its datasheet (Fisher ET, Table 14, pp. 20–21) lists valve plug seal ring materials and temperature limits as follows — no separate "piston ring" materials are stated:

- **2-piece valve plug seal** (standard for NPS 1–6 valves except those with Cavitrol III cage):
  - Carbon-filled PTFE: −73 to 232 °C (−100 to 450 °F)
  - Ethylene-propylene: −40 to 232 °C (−40 to 450 °F); good with hot water/steam and most fire-resistant hydraulic oils, but not with petroleum-based fluids/hydrocarbons
  - Fluorocarbon: −18 to 204 °C (0 to 400 °F); for high-temperature air, hydrocarbons, certain chemicals/solvents; not for steam or ammonia, not recommended for water above 82 °C
  - Nitrile (air and hydrocarbons): −40 to 71 °C (−40 to 160 °F); nitrile (other compatible fluids): −40 to 82 °C (−40 to 180 °F); nitrile cannot be used with fire-resistant hydraulic oils

- **Spring-loaded valve plug seal** (standard for NPS 8 valves, and NPS 1–6 with Cavitrol III cages; optional otherwise):

   OR toLower(source_description) CONTAINS 'temperature'
WITH item, d, printed_value, datum_label, case_label, source_title, source_description

     max(d.lis__datumValue) AS maximum_temperature,
     collect({
       numeric_value: d.lis__datumValue,

         OR toLower(coalesce(c.rdfs__label, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum'
    }
    OR EXISTS {
      MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(s:plm__PCA_100029513)
      WHERE toLower(coalesce(s.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'temperature'
         OR toLower(coalesce(s.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'fluid'
         OR toLower(coalesce(s.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'temperature'
         OR toLower(coalesce(s.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'fluid'
    }
  )

OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(caseNode:plm__PCA_100029524)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029514]->(footnote)

  caseNode: caseNode,

  section: section,
  temperature: d.lis__datumValue
}) AS rows
WITH rows,
     reduce(lowest = null, row IN rows |
       CASE
         WHEN row.temperature IS NULL THEN lowest
         WHEN lowest IS NULL OR row.temperature < lowest THEN row.temperature
         ELSE lowest
       END
     ) AS lowestTemperature
UNWIND rows AS row
RETURN row.item.tag AS tag,
       row.d.plm__PCA_100029521 AS label,
       row.d.plm__PCA_100029522 AS maximum_fluid_temperature,
       row.temperature AS numeric_temperature,
       row.caseNode.rdfs__label AS case,

       row.section.plm__PCA_100029521 AS source_title,
       row.section.dct__type AS source_type,
       row.section.dct__description AS source_description,
       row.d.schema__pageStart AS page,
       row.temperature = lowestTemperature AS is_lowest
ORDER BY tag
LIMIT 200

    AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)
    AND (
      toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'allowable pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '')) CONTAINS 'allowable pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum pressure'
    )
    AND (
      EXISTS {
        MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(c:plm__PCA_100029524)
        WHERE toLower(coalesce(c.rdfs__label, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
           OR toLower(coalesce(c.rdfs__label, '')) CONTAINS 'allowable pressure'
           OR toLower(coalesce(c.rdfs__label, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum pressure'
      }
      OR NOT EXISTS { (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(:plm__PCA_100029524) }
      OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'allowable pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum pressure'
    )
  RETURN d AS hit
  UNION
  WITH dev
  MATCH (s:plm__PCA_100029513)
  WHERE s.document_id = dev.document_id
    AND (
      toLower(coalesce(s.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(s.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'allowable pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(s.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(s.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(s.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'allowable pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(s.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum pressure'
    )
  RETURN s AS hit
}

MATCH (recipient)-[:DESCRIBED_BY]->(dev)
CALL {

    AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)
    AND (
      toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'temperature'
      OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '')) CONTAINS 'temperature'
      OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum'
      OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum'
    )
  RETURN d, null AS section
  UNION
  WITH dev
  MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(section:plm__PCA_100029513)
  WHERE d.document_id = dev.document_id
    AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)
    AND (
      toLower(coalesce(section.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'temperature'
      OR toLower(coalesce(section.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'temperature'
      OR toLower(coalesce(section.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum'
      OR toLower(coalesce(section.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum'
    )
  RETURN d, section
}
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(caseNode:plm__PCA_100029524)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029514]->(footnote)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(sourceSection:plm__PCA_100029513)
WITH recipient, d, caseNode, footnote, coalesce(section, sourceSection) AS sourceSection
WHERE toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'temperature'
   OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '')) CONTAINS 'temperature'
   OR toLower(coalesce(caseNode.rdfs__label, '')) CONTAINS 'temperature'
   OR toLower(coalesce(sourceSection.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'temperature'
   OR toLower(coalesce(sourceSection.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'temperature'
WITH recipient, d, caseNode, footnote, sourceSection,
     toFloat(d.lis__datumValue) AS temperature
WITH collect({
  tag: recipient.tag,
  label: d.plm__PCA_100029521,
  value: d.plm__PCA_100029522,
  case: caseNode.rdfs__label,
  footnote: footnote.plm__PCA_100029522,
  source_title: sourceSection.plm__PCA_100029521,
  source_type: sourceSection.dct__type,
  source_description: sourceSection.dct__description,
  page: coalesce(d.schema__pageStart, sourceSection.schema__pageStart),
  temperature: temperature
}) AS rows
WITH rows, reduce(lowest = null, row IN rows |
  CASE WHEN row.temperature IS NOT NULL AND (lowest IS NULL OR row.temperature < lowest)
       THEN row.temperature ELSE lowest END
) AS lowest
UNWIND rows AS row
RETURN row.tag AS tag, row.label AS label, row.value AS value,
       row.case AS case, row.footnote AS footnote,
       row.source_title AS source_title, row.source_type AS source_type,
       row.source_description AS source_description, row.page AS page,
       row.temperature AS temperature,
       row.temperature = lowest AS is_lowest
ORDER BY tag, label, value
LIMIT 200

GV-1-2 is a Type 165 servo-controlled 2/2-way solenoid diaphragm valve (fail-safe to close). The datasheet has no troubleshooting section, but two specs are most relevant to "hums but won't open":

- **Minimum differential pressure of 0.5 bar** is required to open and close the valve. Since it is servo-operated, the pressure difference across the valve does the actual opening work — if Δp is below 0.5 bar, the coil can hum while the diaphragm never lifts.
- **Supply voltage must match the type plate (24V DC, 230V or 115V AC, tolerance ±10 %)**. Under-voltage or a wrong voltage/current type could also produce humming without opening, though the datasheet does not explicitly state this as a fault cause.

Other limits worth checking against conditions: media must be clean liquids without solid particles, viscosity max 21 mm²/s, media temperature 0 to +50 °C (PVC housing), and operating pressure range 0.5–6 bar (PN 6). The datasheet lists these limits but does not link them to the fault.

{"answer": "GV-1-2 is described as a GF Piping Systems Type 165 2/2-way solenoid valve. A humming coil that fails to open suggests an electrical or differential-pressure problem: the valve needs a minimum differential pressure of 0.5 bar to open and close (and its operating pressure range is 0.5–6 bar, with Δp = 1 bar listed as the test condition), so if the differential pressure across the valve is below 0.5 bar it will hum but not open. Also check the coil supply: the valve is rated for 24V DC, 230V 50/60 Hz or 115V 50/60 Hz with a voltage tolerance of ±10 %, and the type plate's voltage and current type must be observed — a wrong or out-of-tolerance supply voltage (or a coil set mismatched to the supply, e.g. the 110V AC vs 230V AC vs 24V DC coil sets) could cause hum without opening. FT-10-1 is a Rosemount 3051 transmitter, and its failure direction is not fixed — it is user-selectable. The factory default ships with the alarm set to High (≥ 21.75 mA for HART 4-20 mA output; ≥ 22.5 mA for some options), with Low alarm being ≤ 3.75 mA. You change the direction either at ordering (option codes C4/CN for NAMUR-compliant levels, CR/CS for custom levels, CT for Rosemount standard low) or in the field: for the HART 4-20 mA output (code A) via a jumper/switch on the transmitter, and for the 1-5 Vdc low-power output (code M) via an internal jumper (failure levels there are below 0.94 V for low or above 5.4 V for high). Custom alarm levels can be set from 20.2–23.0 mA (high) and 3.6–3.8 mA (low), with the low alarm 0.1 mA below low saturation and the high alarm 0.1 mA above high saturation. Note that for digital outputs (Fieldbus/PROFIBUS/wireless), no high/low analog drive applies — a failure is passed as an alert and status with the process variable.

WITH item, label, printed_value, numeric_value, case_label, footnote,

  source_title: source_title,

  source_description: source_description,

       row.source_title AS source_title,
       row.source_type AS source_type,
       row.source_description AS source_description,
       row.page AS page,
       row.numeric_value = lowest_temperature AS is_lowest
ORDER BY tag
LIMIT 200

  RETURN d AS datum, caseNode, footnote, section

  WHERE d.document_id = dev.document_id
    AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)
    AND (toLower(coalesce(section.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'temperature'
      OR toLower(coalesce(section.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'temperature')
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(caseNode)

WITH item, datum, caseNode, footnote, section,
     datum.lis__datumValue AS numericTemperature
WITH collect({
  tag: item.tag,
  label: datum.plm__PCA_100029521,
  value: datum.plm__PCA_100029522,
  numericTemperature: numericTemperature,
  caseLabel: caseNode.rdfs__label,

  sourceType: section.dct__type,
  sourceDescription: section.dct__description,
  page: coalesce(datum.schema__pageStart, section.schema__pageStart)
}) AS rows
WITH rows, reduce(lowest = null, row IN rows |
  CASE WHEN row.numericTemperature IS NOT NULL AND

       row.sourceTitle AS sourceTitle,
       row.sourceType AS sourceType,

MATCH (src:PlantItem {tag: 'E-46-1'})-[:send_to]->(item:PlantItem)-[:DESCRIBED_BY]->(dev:Resource)
MATCH (d)
WHERE d.document_id = dev.document_id
  AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)
  AND toLower(d.plm__PCA_100029521) CONTAINS 'pressure'
  AND (toLower(d.plm__PCA_100029521) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable'
       OR toLower(d.plm__PCA_100029521) CONTAINS 'max allowable'
       OR toLower(d.plm__PCA_100029521) CONTAINS 'maximum working'
       OR toLower(d.plm__PCA_100029521) CONTAINS 'max working')
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(c:plm__PCA_100029524)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029514]->(fn:plm__PCA_100029505)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(s:plm__PCA_100029513)
WITH item, d, c, fn, s
WHERE d IS NOT NULL
WITH item, d, c, fn, s, d.lis__datumValue AS pressure_value
CALL {
  WITH item, pressure_value
  MATCH (src:PlantItem {tag: 'E-46-1'})-[:send_to]->(candidate:PlantItem)-[:DESCRIBED_BY]->(dev:Resource)
  MATCH (pd)
  WHERE candidate = item
    AND pd.document_id = dev.document_id
    AND (pd:plm__PCA_100029511 OR pd:plm__PCA_100029508 OR pd:plm__PCA_100029510)
    AND toLower(pd.plm__PCA_100029521) CONTAINS 'pressure'
    AND (toLower(pd.plm__PCA_100029521) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable'
         OR toLower(pd.plm__PCA_100029521) CONTAINS 'max allowable'
         OR toLower(pd.plm__PCA_100029521) CONTAINS 'maximum working'
         OR toLower(pd.plm__PCA_100029521) CONTAINS 'max working')

MATCH (:PlantItem {tag: 'E-34-2'})-[:send_to]->(item:PlantItem)
MATCH (item)-[:DESCRIBED_BY]->(dev:Resource)
CALL {
  WITH dev
  MATCH (d)
  WHERE d.document_id = dev.document_id
    AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(c:plm__PCA_100029524)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029514]->(f)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(s:plm__PCA_100029513)
  WHERE toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'max allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '')) CONTAINS 'max allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(c.rdfs__label, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(c.rdfs__label, '')) CONTAINS 'max allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(s.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(s.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(s.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'max allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(s.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'max allowable pressure'
  RETURN d.plm__PCA_100029521 AS label,
         d.plm__PCA_100029522 AS value,
         d.lis__datumValue AS numericValue,
         c.rdfs__label AS caseLabel,
         f.plm__PCA_100029522 AS footnote,
         s.plm__PCA_100029521 AS sourceTitle,
         s.dct__type AS sourceType,
         s.dct__description AS sourceDescription,
         coalesce(d.schema__pageStart, s.schema__pageStart) AS page
}
WITH item, label, value, numericValue, caseLabel, footnote, sourceTitle, sourceType, sourceDescription, page
WITH collect({tag: item.tag, label: label, value: value, numericValue: numericValue,
              caseLabel: caseLabel, footnote: footnote, sourceTitle: sourceTitle,
              sourceType: sourceType, sourceDescription: sourceDescription, page: page}) AS rows
WITH rows, reduce(lowest = null, r IN rows |
  CASE WHEN r.numericValue IS NOT NULL AND (lowest IS NULL OR r.numericValue < lowest)
       THEN r.numericValue ELSE lowest END) AS lowestPressure
UNWIND rows AS r
RETURN r.tag AS tag, r.label AS label, r.value AS maximumAllowablePressure,
       r.caseLabel AS caseLabel, r.footnote AS footnote, r.sourceTitle AS sourceTitle,
       r.sourceType AS sourceType, r.sourceDescription AS sourceDescription, r.page AS page,
       r.numericValue = lowestPressure AS isLowest
ORDER BY tag, label
LIMIT 200;

MATCH (d)

  AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(caseNode:plm__PCA_100029524)

OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(source:plm__PCA_100029513)
WITH item, d, caseNode, footnote, source,
     toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '') + ' ' +
             coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '') + ' ' +
             coalesce(caseNode.rdfs__label, '') + ' ' +
             coalesce(source.plm__PCA_100029521, '') + ' ' +
             coalesce(source.dct__description, '')) AS searchText
WHERE searchText CONTAINS 'pressure'
  AND (searchText CONTAINS 'maximum' OR searchText CONTAINS 'max.' OR
       searchText CONTAINS 'allowable' OR searchText CONTAINS 'permissible')
RETURN item.tag AS tag,
       d.plm__PCA_100029521 AS label,
       d.plm__PCA_100029522 AS printed_value,
       caseNode.rdfs__label AS case_label,
       footnote.plm__PCA_100029522 AS footnote,
       source.plm__PCA_100029521 AS source_title,
       source.dct__type AS source_type,
       source.dct__description AS source_description,
       coalesce(d.schema__pageStart, source.schema__pageStart) AS page
ORDER BY tag, label
LIMIT 200;

{"tool":"drawing","question":"Trace the process flow path from E-7-2 to GV-47-2 and list, in flow order, every item on that path that has a datasheet, with its tag. Include the endpoints if they are on the path."}

MATCH (a:PlantItem {tag: 'E-7-2'}), (b:PlantItem {tag: 'GV-47-2'})
MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:line_to*]->(b))
WITH nodes(p) AS path
UNWIND range(0, size(path) - 1) AS i
WITH path[i] AS item, i
WHERE item.tag IS NOT NULL
RETURN item.tag AS tag
ORDER BY i;

       OR toLower(coalesce(dt.plm__PCA_100029521,'')) CONTAINS 'fluid temp'
       OR toLower(coalesce(dt.plm__PCA_100029521,'')) CONTAINS 'operating temp'

OPTIONAL MATCH (dt)-[:plm__PCA_100029514]->(fn)
OPTIONAL MATCH (dt)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(cs)

    AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)

     OR toLower(coalesce(c.rdfs__label, '')) CONTAINS 'pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(s.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(s.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'pressure'
  RETURN DISTINCT d
  UNION
  WITH dev
  MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(s:plm__PCA_100029513)

- **BV-34-1** (Flowserve Worcester F51/F52 ball valve): the datasheet does not state a single maximum allowable pressure; it depends on pressure class, body material group, seat material and temperature per the ASME B16.34 pressure/temperature chart. Depending on configuration it ranges from about 18.9–19.8 bar (Class 150) up to about 49.7–51.8 bar (Class 300) at low temperature, possibly capped lower by the seat material.

The lowest maximum allowable pressure among these is therefore the pumps' 250 psi (≈17.2 bar), which is below even the lowest Class 150 valve rating (~18.9 bar) — so P-101-1 and P-34-2 have the lowest maximum allowable pressure.    toLower(text) CONTAINS 'max allowable pressure' OR
   toLower(text) CONTAINS 'allowable pressure' OR
   toLower(text) CONTAINS 'maximum pressure'))
WITH DISTINCT item, d, caseNode, footnote, section, unit
WITH item, d, caseNode, footnote, section, unit,
     coalesce(d.lis__datumValue, toFloat(d.plm__PCA_100029522)) AS pressureValue

  tag: item.tag,
  pressure: d.plm__PCA_100029522,
  pressureValue: pressureValue,

  footnote: footnote.plm__PCA_100029522,
  sourceTitle: section.plm__PCA_100029521,
  page: d.schema__pageStart
}) AS results
WITH results, reduce(lowest = null, row IN results |
  CASE WHEN row.pressureValue IS NOT NULL AND
                 (lowest IS NULL OR row.pressureValue < lowest)

       row.pressure AS maximumAllowablePressure,
       row.pressureValue AS pressureValue,
       row.unit AS unit,
       row.condition AS condition,
       row.footnote AS footnote,
       row.sourceTitle AS sourceTitle,
       row.page AS page,
       row.pressureValue = lowestPressure AS isLowest

MATCH (d)

  AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(c:plm__PCA_100029524)

OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(s:plm__PCA_100029513)
WITH item, d, c, fn, s
WHERE toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'temperature'
  AND (toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum'
    OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'max')
WITH collect({
  tag: item.tag,
  label: d.plm__PCA_100029521,
  value: d.plm__PCA_100029522,
  numericValue: d.lis__datumValue,
  condition: c.rdfs__label,
  footnote: fn.plm__PCA_100029522,
  sourceTitle: s.plm__PCA_100029521,
  page: d.schema__pageStart
}) AS rows
WITH rows, reduce(lowest = null, row IN rows |
  CASE
    WHEN row.numericValue IS NULL THEN lowest

    ELSE lowest

UNWIND rows AS row
RETURN row.tag AS tag,
       row.label AS label,
       row.value AS value,
       row.numericValue AS numericValue,
       row.condition AS condition,
       row.footnote AS footnote,
       row.sourceTitle AS sourceTitle,
       row.page AS page,
       lowestMaximumTemperature,
       row.numericValue = lowestMaximumTemperature AS hasLowestMaximumTemperature
ORDER BY tag, label
